en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand formal dining hall in a European palace or stately home. A very long, formally set dining table with many identical chairs runs along the room, laid with white tablecloths, candelabras, flower arrangements and folded napkins. The space has a high ornate ceiling with elaborate molding and large multi‑globe chandeliers, wood‑paneled lower walls, and large double doors. Above the panelling hang large framed portraits of aristocratic figures and several classical busts placed on cabinets and shelves, giving the impression of a royal or noble residence prepared for a banquet.
